blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Iloilo City government and the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) intensified security measures following reports of online threats targeting at least two public schools in the city last week, prompting a swift response to ensure the safety of students and school personnel. On Monday, Mayor Raisa Treñas immediately convened an emergency meeting with representatives from 26 private schools offering high school and senior high school programs, alongside the Philippine National Police (PNP) and other partner agencies, to address the situation and establish concrete security protocols. “As a mother and as Mayor, I do not want to wait […]...
